annotations.title: Withdraw from a phone number purchase

description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Withdraw from a phone number purchase

Uses the withdrawal right for a purchased number: the number leaves your account at once and is taken off its agent. This cannot be undone. Only numbers of your own account.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.
